2607.04982.title: Joint Velocity Slope Diffusion Prior for Structurally Constrained Velocity Model Building
2607.04982.paper_summary: High-resolution velocity models are crucial for reservoir characterization and subsurface delineation. However, the band limited nature of our surface recorded data limits resolution. Utilizing well measurements to enhance the resolution of our subsurface models is an important objective. To this end, we present a diffusion-guided framework for structurally preconditioned velocity-model reconstruction from sparse well-log information. The proposed approach combines plane-wave PDE regularization, structurally preconditioned inversion, and measurement-guided diffusion posterior sampling within a unified formulation. Local structural slopes estimated through plane-wave destruction are used both to propagate well information along geological dip directions and to guide the diffusion sampling process through a joint velocity--slope generative prior. Numerical experiments on the Volve synthetic model and the Viking Graben field dataset demonstrate that the proposed framework improves structural continuity, lateral consistency, and geological realism compared with conventional structurally preconditioned inversion approaches while maintaining computationally practical inference through DDIM sampling.
2607.04982.paper_summary_zh: 高解析度速度模型對於油藏特徵描述和地下 delineation 至關重要。<lb/>然而，我們的表面記錄數據的帶限特性限制了解析度。<lb/>利用井測量來增強我們地下模型的解析度是一個重要目標。<lb/>為此，我們提出了一個擴散引導的框架，用於從稀疏的井日誌信息中重建結構預處理的速度模型。<lb/>所提出的方法將平面波 PDE 正則化、結構預處理反演和測量引導的擴散後驗取樣結合在一個統一的公式中。<lb/>通過平面波破壞估計的局部結構斜率用於沿著地質傾斜方向傳播井信息，並通過聯合速度-斜率生成先驗引導擴散取樣過程。<lb/>在 Volve 合成模型和 Viking Graben 田野數據集上的數值實驗表明，所提出的框架在改善結構連續性、側向一致性和地質現實性方面，相較於傳統的結構預處理反演方法具有優勢，同時通過 DDIM 取樣保持計算上可行的推斷。
